I've asked the team for your new ship date. They're offline now, so they'll pick this up Monday at 10am ET and email you the answer. Tracking also goes to (email hidden) as soon as the box leaves.

You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
